text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error-rate detected for production gateway -> service-group A (5xx and timeouts). Alert trig: route_success_rate < 90% over 2m. Paging eva (oncall).

eva (oncall): saw the page, jumping in. initial dashboard shows 5xx spike starting ~3m ago, traffic steady. Any deploys in last 15m?

maya (prod-eng): no deploys from platform side. We did push a routing tweak 18m ago to shift weight for canary but should be stable.

ben (sre): I'm seeing per-route traces: requests to /v1/generate are getting retried by the LB, and upstream is returning 502s. Looks like retries are causing fanout to a small subset of backends -> overload -> 5xx.

lucas (infra): oh interesting — Envoy stats show increase in `upstream_rq_pending_overflow` and `upstream_cx_destroy` on cluster svc-A. Circuit breaker counters bumped. Could be route-priority inversion: some hosts got >80% of traffic.

cassie (support): we already have two customer tickets; both report timeouts and 502s. ETA asked by PMs.

eva (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable retries on gateway for /v1/generate to stop fanout 2) temporarily widen circuit-breaker thresholds on svc-A 3) scale svc-A by 2x. Will coordinate.

ben (sre): agree. Disabling retries first to avoid amplifying failures. I'm going to push a safe route patch to turn off retries for that route.

lucas (infra): if you need quick action I can patch Envoy config with this one-off action via admin API: `curl -X POST http://envoy-admin:9901/cluster/service-a/config -d '@payload.json'` — but prefer sync via control-plane if time-critical.

ben (sre): doing control-plane patch now: applying `retries: { retry_on: none }` for route `/v1/generate` on gateway. Pushing.

incident-bot: Deploy started by ben. CI checks passed. Rolling config to 6 gateway nodes.

maya (prod-eng): monitoring logs and metrics. Also enabling debug-level logs on gateway for 5m to catch request headers.

ben (sre): patch rolled to 4/6 nodes, latency improved on those nodes. 5xx rate decreased by ~30% on those nodes.

lucas (infra): scaling svc-A replicas from 8 -> 16 now. K8s HPA kicking in.

cassie (support): filed an update to customers: "Investigating elevated 5xx and timeouts for generate API. Mitigations in progress; will update in 15m." (posted)

eva (oncall): next: widen CBs to avoid instant fail-open. Ben, can you adjust `max_pending_requests` and `max_connections` for svc-A cluster?

ben (sre): applying CB bump: set `max_pending_requests: 500`, `max_connections: 400` (was 100/80). Rolling.

```yaml
# snippet of the cluster patch
name: svc-A
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    - max_connections: 400
      max_pending_requests: 500
```

ben (sre): CB change live, rolling. Watch metrics.

mametrics: (observability) notable: prefix_kv_cache_hit_rate unchanged; but `upstream_rq_retries` now dropping to near 0 after retry-disable.

maya (prod-eng): backend error logs show an internal `timeout waiting for model` error repeatedly on host svc-A-3. Example:

```
ERROR [2026-03-15T02:12:34Z] model_request.cpp:93 timeout waiting for model load after 120s
```

ben (sre): that explains persistent 502s — a subset of hosts slow to serve inference, causing earlier retry amplification. Scaling should help and retries disabled reduces pressure.

eva (oncall): we should mark svc-A-3 as drained for now and investigate. Lucas, can you cordon/evict that pod? I'll keep it out of LB.

lucas (infra): cordon + drain in progress: `kubectl drain svc-A-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

ben (sre): draining done; traffic redistributed. 5xx rate overall down to normal thresholds on gateway. Still monitoring.

cassie (support): sent follow-up to customers: "Mitigations deployed. We've disabled gateway retries and removed one problematic host. We expect normal service within minutes. We'll follow up with root cause." :thumbsup:

eva (oncall): quick postmortem notes: probable root cause chain: a slow model load in a small subset of hosts -> retries at gateway amplified traffic to slow hosts -> circuit breakers tripped causing more 5xx -> customer-visible timeouts. Contributing factor: route weight skew after earlier routing change concentrated traffic on those hosts.

maya (prod-eng): action items:
- formalize a safe-rollback for route weighting (we'll add automated guard to avoid >70% weight to any host)
- add a short-circuit to disable retries automatically when `upstream_rq_errors` spikes for a route
- add alerting to detect rapid per-host traffic skew

ben (sre): I'll open a ticket to add an automation that temporarily flips `retry_on` to none if `upstream_rq_retries` > X and `upstream_rq_5xx` spikes.

lucas (infra): also adding health-check stricter thresholds so hosts that repeatedly time out are removed faster.

cassie (support): customers acknowledged. They asked for timeline and RCA once complete.

eva (oncall): status: mitigations successful, 5xx returned to baseline, incident resolved for now. Leaving tracking ticket open for RCA and follow-ups. Reassigning to maya/ben/lucas for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident resolved by eva (oncall). Duration: ~27 minutes. Severity: Sev2. Postmortem requested. @maya (prod-eng) @ben (sre) @lucas (infra) assigned.

ben (sre): quick logs dump for RCA (attached to ticket):
```
[svc-A-3] 2026-03-15T02:11:10Z ModelLoad::start
[svc-A-3] 2026-03-15T02:12:34Z ERROR timeout waiting for model load
[svc-A-3] 2026-03-15T02:13:00Z connection reset by peer
```

maya (prod-eng): will draft the RCA. Thanks team. :heart:"
